notes: Check Kontext asks a question the worker can actually answer. The probe works by handing ComfyUI a graph whose only fault is a model filename that cannot exist, so the refusal lists every file that does — but ComfyUI checks that a graph is wired correctly before it checks any of the values in it, and the probe's own wiring was wrong: it fed conditioning into an image input. The worker rejected the wiring and never reached the question. The probe is now a complete, valid graph — borrowing CLIP and VAE from the checkpoint already on the volume — so the refusal comes back with the model list in it, and a worker too old to know the Kontext nodes still announces itself the same way. A type mismatch is no longer misread as a missing node either.
